notes: CNIPA front page: the numbered INID fields, the agency, the IPC list and the (54) title. Ends at the title block rather than at the page boundary, because (57) 摘要 on the same page is a different subject and gets its own section. Line 1 is the document's H1, which build_enriched.py writes from the patent id and which no page carries.

The abstract recites the whole three-step route in compressed form and names every reagent class, so A1 will find compounds here, but it states no charge, no temperature and no yield and is therefore not a procedure. Lines 42-43 are the vertical publication number printed down the left margin of the front page, a page artifact kept with the section that surrounds it per rule 8.

Ten claims on one page. Claim 1 is a three-step process claim and claims 2 to 10 are dependent, each fixing a molar ratio, a temperature range or a solvent list for one of those three steps. The three steps of claim 1 are the procedure; the dependent claims add parameters to them rather than new steps, so the count is 3 and not 10.

Opens with the invention title repeated at the head of the description (line 82), which the vision pass recorded with no [00NN] marker because none is printed. Kept here rather than in Bibliographic Data because it sits inside the description body, on a different page.

[0002] to [0004] are product background: the chemical name of tembotrione, its mode of action as an HPPD inhibitor, and its registration history. [0005] to [0009] are five prior-art routes, four patents and one journal article, each characterised by its starting material, the reagent objected to, and a yield. contains_procedure is true for those five and not for the product background. They are one-line characterisations rather than worked procedures, so A2 should expect no charges, no conditions and no workup, and should attribute every one of them to prior art. Setting this false would have been the safer-looking call and would have silently dropped the five routes this patent exists to improve on, including CN104292137A, which is this repo's own reference run.

Two tellings of the same route. [0012] to [0018] recite it in words as three steps, and [0019] to [0027] add the preferred molar ratios, temperatures, catalysts and solvents for each. [0028] then says the reaction equations follow and [0029] carries the drawn scheme, which is one graphic holding five arrows. 3 prose steps plus 5 drawn arrows is 8. The two tellings agree here, unlike in the reference run, but they are still emitted separately per A2 rule 5f: the drawing splits step 3 into acid chloride formation and acylation, and it draws them in the reverse of their chemical order, the acylation above the acid chloride formation that supplies it.

heading_text_zh: 本发明的有益效果在于：
heading_text_en: The beneficial effects of the present invention are as follows:
notes: Four numbered advantages, each naming the chemical it replaces: hydrobromic acid for bromine, market-available 2,2,2-trifluoroethanol for the trifluoroethoxide, DMF for acetonitrile, and no sodium methoxide at all. Compounds but no procedure.

The single boilerplate sentence that opens the embodiments region, saying the examples do not limit the invention. No section type in the closed list fits a lead-in, so it is `other` rather than being folded into Example 1, which would put a sentence about the whole document inside one example.

Three numbered steps under one 实施例 marker, each preceded by a drawn structure of that step's product at [0039], [0042] and [0045]. One section, not three, per rule 6. Step 2 and step 3 are each two transformations run without isolating the intermediate, which is A2's one-pot case rather than a section boundary. Runs across the p06/p07 page break in the middle of [0043].

Same three steps as Example 1 at different conditions: dichloromethane in place of 1,2-dichloroethane and 45 to 50 C in place of 75 to 80 C in step 1, DMF in place of tetrahydrofuran in step 2. Drawn product structures at [0050], [0053] and [0056].

Same three steps. This is the only example that uses m-chloroperoxybenzoic acid rather than azobisisobutyronitrile as the step 1 catalyst, and the only one that runs step 2 at 0 to 5 C. Drawn product structures at [0061], [0064] and [0067].
Same three steps, with chloroform as the step 1 solvent. Drawn product structures at [0072], [0075] and [0078]. Runs across the p09/p10 page break in the middle of [0073].

The prior-art conditions the invention is measured against, run by the applicant: bromine in carbon tetrachloride for step 1, sodium methoxide in DMF for step 2, and acetonitrile with acetone cyanohydrin dosed in drops for step 3. Same three transformations, so 3 steps. Reports lower yields throughout and, unlike every 实施例, gives no purity for any product and no mass for the step 2 product. Drawn product structures at [0082], [0085] and [0088].

[0090], the last paragraph, which reads the examples against the comparative example and states the patent's core claim: low-toxicity, low-hazard chemicals, with the higher yield described as unexpected. A second beneficial_effects section is deliberate; section types are not unique and this paragraph is a conclusion drawn from the experiments, which the section at index 6 is not.
